methods.title: Catacombs prayer setup
methods.note: A multi-combat option with fewer returns to controls. Keep prayer and dragonfire protection covered; other assigned locations may not permit this choice.

methods.title: Sustain melee
methods.note: Sustain from food or healing gear supports longer trips. Carry a finishing item; the Gargoyle smasher reward reduces finishing inputs.

methods.title: Short unextended task
methods.note: An unextended assignment can be a short, low-effort way to preserve the task streak. Compare your actual supplies and clear time.

methods.title: High-stat sustained combat
methods.note: A low-effort option at high combat stats. Larger assignments may take longer, so use your own measured rate and supply cost to judge it.
